summary: Learn essential waste reduction and recycling techniques tailored for the oil and gas industry. Enroll in our training to drive environmental responsibility.
lede: Waste audit training for oil and gas covers identifying operational waste streams, profiling materials, and calculating waste intensity and diversion. For environmental, HSE, operations, sustainability, and waste management professionals, it provides methods to check segregation, design recycling systems, and oversee contractor handling. Exercises also cover hazardous-waste controls, manifest tracking, KPI dashboards, and site reporting for day-to-day waste decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage or influence waste, recycling, and environmental controls in oil and gas operations. It suits you if you need practical tools for audits, recycling design, contractor oversight, and site-level reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with oil and gas operations, HSE, environmental compliance, or site services support. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for calculations and reporting exercises. If available, bring a recent waste log, contractor manifest, disposal summary, or site inspection record.
